attention.title: Gold and silver lose $1 trillion in value in a single day
attention.why: With the odds of an October Fed hike rising to the 66-70% range, the US 10-year yield climbing to around 5.20% and a stronger dollar, gold fell 3% below $4,200 and silver dropped 5%; about $1.05 trillion was wiped from precious metals' total market value in a single day.

attention.title: US 10-year yield at its highest since 2007, odds of an October Fed hike at 68.1%
attention.why: The 10-year yield rose 8.5 basis points on Monday to 5.26%; per CME FedWatch, the odds of a 25 bp Fed hike on October 28 rose to 68.1% from 64.2% on Friday. Macquarie's Thierry Wizman attributes the rise more to heavy bond issuance than to inflation.

attention.title: Legal uncertainty over funds with unpublished prices in the Takasbank PBKL liquidation
attention.why: Until now investors in orders entering PBKL were treated as Takasbank creditors, but the new statement says instructions not executed due to default or unpublished prices are also covered by the liquidation; which price and legal status apply to funds whose price was not published on September 16 still needs to be clarified.

attention.title: Trump's 9 p.m. announcement tonight could set the market's direction
attention.why: Şatıroğlu expects Trump to make a market-friendly statement as he prepares for the midterms; he wrote that Brent rose to $105 in Asia, reaching a past resistance zone, and that he expects it to turn lower from here.

attention.title: Meta enters enterprise AI, hires MongoDB's CEO to run it
